Customs Act 1969: Section 25(3) of this Act empowers the Government to determine tariff values and minimum values for the purpose of levying customs duty on imported goods.
S.R.O. 159-AIN/2012: This previous statutory order is repealed and replaced by the current notification.
Imported Goods: The order specifies tariff values for certain petroleum and mineral oil products as listed in the provided schedule.

The order sets minimum valuation thresholds for various consumer goods, including confectionery, food products, vehicle tires, communication cards, batteries, and optical items, based on their origin and technical specifications.
